contexts.text: Hence it is that the Lord inflows with good into a humble and contrite heart.
Instead of repentance, we take contrition...
Contrition, which is said to precede faith, and to be followed by the consolation of the Gospel, is not repentance. General article.
A species of anxiety, grief, and terror, which they call contrition. Explained.
Whether this contrition is repentance, or not. (Explained.)
As contrition is not repentance, is it of any moment? Explained.
Hence it is evident, that contrition, not being repentance, is not anything.
Whether there is any such contrition without repentance. Explained.
From these things... I am confirmed that contrition, unless it is repentance... is a mere freak of the fancy.
The contrition which is held to precede the modern faith, is not temptation...
We have believed that conscience is contrition...
